newsitem.title: GERMANY: Fresenius Medical shares issued at 125 DM.
newsitem.headline: Fresenius Medical shares issued at 125 DM.

text.p: Preference shares in Fresenius Medical Care AG are to be issued at a price of 125 marks each, Dresdner Bank, as leader of the issuing consortium, said on Saturday evening.
The group, a unit of Fresenius AG, is issuing five million new non-voting preference shares worth a nominal 25 million marks.
Fresenius Medical was formed in a series of transactions culminating in the combination of the global dialysis business of Fresenius AG and the global dialysis business of U.S.-based W.R. Grace & Co.
The company has the option to exercise a greenshoe of 750,000 shares over the next 30 days.
Fresenius Medical shares closed at 138.60 marks each in Frankfurt on Friday.
